Startup locations

The Windows mechanisms scanned to discover automatic and event-triggered launches.

This is an inventory of launch mechanisms plus a heuristic for windowless processes. A running process may have been started by another app, a service or a system event.

Settings

Display preferences, text readability, and administrator privileges.

Display & Readability
Text size & UI scale
Scale up the text and interface elements for easier reading. You can also press Ctrl + and Ctrl - anytime to zoom.
Show Windows and Microsoft system components
Includes Windows' own services and system packages. Hidden by default to keep the list focused on your apps.
Privileges & Startup
Always start as administrator
Windows will prompt for administrator rights automatically whenever Background Manager is launched, giving you full process inspection and access to reconfigure services and tasks.
Safety & GuardrailsAlways active
Backup before every change
